name: cyclotomic_expand_eq_cyclotomic_mul
statement: ℕ} (hp : Nat.Prime p) (hdiv : ¬p ∣ n) (R : Type*) [CommRing R] : expand R p (cyclotomic n R) = cyclotomic (n * p) R * cyclotomic n R

name: cyclotomic_expand_eq_cyclotomic
statement: ℕ} (hp : Nat.Prime p) (hdiv : p ∣ n) (R : Type*) [CommRing R] : expand R p (cyclotomic n R) = cyclotomic (n * p) R

name: cyclotomic_irreducible_pow_of_irreducible_pow
statement: ℕ} (hp : Nat.Prime p) {R} [CommRing R] [IsDomain R] {n m : ℕ} (hmn : m ≤ n) (h : Irreducible (cyclotomic (p ^ n) R)) : Irreducible (cyclotomic (p ^ m) R)
